UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Application-level user profile and default market preferences keyed by Firebase Auth UID. Does not duplicate authentication credentials or passwords.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user owner.

jobTitle.description: Role or title of the user.

preferredCountry.description: Default country filter for ML models.

preferredCategory.description: Default category filter for ML models.

createdAt.description: Server-generated timestamp when the profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server-generated timestamp when the profile was last updated.

PredictionRecord.title: PredictionRecord
PredictionRecord.description: User-specific ML model prediction or segmentation query record associating UID, model identifier, model display name, submitted inputs, model outputs, prediction status, and server timestamps.

uid.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the user who executed the model query.

modelDisplayName.description: Human-readable display name of the ML model.

summaryValue.description: Model output summary string (divergence score verdict, 4-week forecast trajectory summary, or cluster match summary).

numericResult.description: Primary numeric model output (predicted divergence score, 4-week mean forecast, or matched record count).

recordDate.description: Model output reference date or forecast horizon window.

predictionStatus.description: Execution status of the prediction or query.

notes.description: Optional analyst annotation on this prediction run.

createdAt.description: Server-generated timestamp when the prediction record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server-generated timestamp when the prediction record was last updated.

ContactInquiry.title: ContactInquiry
ContactInquiry.description: Enterprise contact or support inquiry submitted by an authenticated user.

uid.description: UID of the authenticated user submitting the inquiry.

senderName.description: Name of the person submitting the inquiry.

createdAt.description: Server-generated timestamp when the inquiry was created.

updatedAt.description: Server-generated timestamp when the inquiry was updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Application-level user profile preferences keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

/users/{userId}/predictions/{predictionI.description: User-specific subcollection storing historical ML model predictions and segmentation queries.

/contactInquiries/{inquiryId}.description: Collection storing Contact Us submissions owned by the submitting user.
